_comment: MCP servers for llmcli.py --tools. ${HOME} and ${CLI_DIR} (this directory) are substituted in command, args and env. --servers a,b,c uses exactly those; --servers +browser,+computer adds disabled ones to the enabled set. Every enabled server's tool schema is sent to the model on every request, so fewer is better on small contexts. An entry's optional "tools" map exposes ONLY the tools named in it, each cut down by its rule: keep = parameters shown to the model, set = arguments forced on every call, append = structured-result fields added to the text result, squeeze_indent = shrink deep indentation, description = replacement text. Every tool call still asks y/n in llmcli.py.

terminal.description: Shell access: run_command (bash -lc, timeout, truncated output). 1 tool.

filesystem.description: File read/write/search rooted at the home directory (covers the synced Dropbox folders too). Official @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem, cut from 16 tools to the 8 that matter.

system.description: OS and network inspection: system_info, list_processes, network_info, http_probe. 4 tools.

fetch.description: Fetch a web page as markdown. Official mcp-server-fetch. 1 tool.

github.description: GitHub through the already-logged-in gh CLI: gh(args). 1 tool. Chosen over the official github-mcp-server because that server's schema is 22 tools / ~7K tokens at its smallest read-only setting and 46 tools / ~13K tokens by default, which does not fit these models' contexts.

claude.description: Escalation: ask_claude(question, context) asks Claude through the claude CLI's normal login, with all of Claude's tools disabled. Capped at 10 calls per session. Uses plan usage. Set ASK_CLAUDE_MODEL in env to change the model (default sonnet). 1 tool.

desktop.description: Desktop applications: open_path (xdg-open a file, folder or URL in its default app), notify (desktop notification). 2 tools.

memory.description: Long-term memory backed by graphify knowledge graphs: remember(title, content) saves a note, recall(query) keyword-searches notes and queries the graphs, graph_search(query, mode) does deep graph traversal (bfs or dfs), graph_status() shows what graphs exist. All models share the same memory. 4 tools.

dropbox.description: The locally synced Dropbox folders (~/*Dropbox*): dropbox_find, dropbox_recent, dropbox_status. Reading and writing the files themselves goes through filesystem. No share links: that needs a Dropbox API token. 3 tools.

toolsuite.description: ~/toolsuite/hackstack: hackstack(command, args) runs the scope-gated hs-* wrappers, hackstack_targets lists allowed targets and usage. The wrappers refuse any target without a targets/*.env profile; this adds no bypass. 2 tools.

browser.disabledReason: Opt-in because of schema size: add it for a session with --servers +browser.
browser.description: Headless browser automation through text page snapshots. Microsoft's official @playwright/mcp (version pinned so it matches the Chromium installed in ~/.cache/ms-playwright; after changing the version run `npx -y @playwright/mcp@<version> install-browser chrome-for-testing`). Cut from 25 tools to 9.

browser_snapshot.description: Read the current page as a text tree. Each element has a ref like e12 to use as target in click and type.

computer.disabledReason: Opt-in because of schema size and because it acts on the live desktop: add it for a session with --servers +computer.
computer.description: Desktop computer use through the accessibility tree (no screenshots, so text-only models can use it): cua-driver's MCP server, cut from 60 tools to 5. Verified on this GNOME Wayland session: launch an app, read its controls as text, click a control, set a text box's value. Keyboard input (type_text, press_key, hotkey) is refused by cua-driver 0.28 on GNOME Wayland, so it is left out; text entry is set_value. Apps that expose no accessibility tree cannot be driven.

launch_app.description: Launch a desktop app by name or command. Returns its pid.

list_windows.description: List open windows: window id (xid), owner pid, title.

get_window_state.description: Read a window's controls as an indexed text tree: [index] role "label". Also returns the snapshot_id that click and set_value need. Use query to show only controls containing some text.

click.description: Click a control by its element_index from the latest get_window_state, passing that result's snapshot_id.

set_value.description: Put text into a text box by element_index and snapshot_id. This is how to type; there is no keyboard tool.

google-drive.disabledReason: No Google OAuth credentials yet. This entry is a scaffold only - see setupDoc for the one-time setup (creates a NEW Google Cloud project, separate from any K&S business project) that the user must do interactively (it requires their own Google login). Once cli/google_credentials.json exists and first-run auth has been completed, flip this to true.
google-drive.description: Google Drive + Docs + Sheets + Slides + Calendar, via @piotr-agier/google-drive-mcp.
notes: The token cache (tokens.json) is left at the server's own default (~/.config/google-drive-mcp/tokens.json), outside this repo - only the OAuth client credentials file lives at credentialsPath above, and only that path needs to be gitignored.
